scope: Unverified summary of the headline national rules for a visiting hobby pilot. Commercial filming, local by-laws and site permissions are not covered.

registrationRequired.note: Registration required above 250 g for hobby use; pilots of 250 g–7 kg need an online course, heavier need a licence.

pilotCertRequired.note: Online course certificate from 250 g; licence above 7 kg.

altitudeNote: General ceiling for hobby flights; lower limits apply near aerodromes and in restricted zones.
maxDistanceRule: Visual line of sight at all times.

insuranceRequired.note: Depends on the aircraft and the operation; not established in this summary. Check the authority for insurance.

importRestriction.note: Import and radio-equipment rules not established in this summary.

noFlyHighlights: Most of Seoul is prohibited (P-73) or restricted; the Han river has limited permitted zones
Near the DMZ and military installations

cityNotes.note: Central Seoul is a no-fly zone; only a few designated riverside parks allow flights with prior approval.
Beaches sit under Gimhae's airspace; check the app.

notes: Written from general knowledge on 2026-09-19 without fetching the sources; not verified. Confirm on the authority page before flying.
